1 冗余分析 （Redundancy Analysis，RDA）的基本概念

1.1 用途

分析多个响应变量与多个解释变量之间的线性关系

1.2 原理

  1. 每个响应变量做多元线性回归，解释变量作为预测因子，得到拟合值矩阵
  2. 对拟合值矩阵进行 PCA，得到约束的主成分坐标（canonical axes）
  3. 本质是约束性主成分分析（PCA)

1.3 前提

  1. 响应变量与解释变量之间应该近似为线性关系
  2. 解释变量之间不存在严重的共线性（VIF检验）
  3. 数据尺度与量纲应该适当处理（包括响应变量和解释变量）

图1. 冗余分析的基本流程示意

2 实际例子

2.1 例1 微生物群落 × 环境因子

Markfeld, M., Titcomb, G., Randriamoria, T. M. et al. Differential assembly of core and non-core host-microbe network s along a land-use change gradient. Ecol Lett 28, no. 11: e70255. (2025). https://doi.org/10.1111/ele.70255

图2. 微生物群落结构对环境因子的响应

Y：样地 × 物种丰度
X：海拔、植被类型、人类干扰程度

生态问题： 微生物群落如何随环境因子变化?

RDA1：代表影响物种丰度最主要的环境梯度
RDA2：代表次要的环境梯度

解读 点的位置表示样点所处的环境条件
物种和环境箭头表示影响群落结构的主因

2.2 例2 功能性状 × 环境因子

Joswig, J.S., Wirth, C., Schuman, M.C. et al. Climatic and soil factors explain the two-dimensional spectrum of global plant trait variation. Nat Ecol Evol 6, 36–50 (2022). https://doi.org/10.1038/s41559-021-01616-8

图3. 植物功能性状对环境因子的响应

Y：物种 × 功能性状
X：温度、降水、实际蒸散发、土壤
生态问题： 功能性状如何随环境因子变化？

RDA1：表示影响物种性状最主要的环境梯度
RDA2：表示次要的环境梯度

解读 点的位置表示物种所处的环境条件
性状与环境箭头表示影响功能性状的主因

3 操作流程

Huang, X., & Chen, S.-C. Fruit-type composition and climate drive latitudinal patterns in fruiting seasons across China. In preparation (2026).

3.1 分析

数据标准化

RDA_indice <- indice %>% 
  dplyr::select(divergence, evenness, M, S) %>% 
  scale() %>% 
  as.data.frame()

RDA_factors <- indice %>% 
  dplyr::select(fleshy_pro, Actual_evapotranspiration, Annual_precipitation, Annual_mean_temperature, Precipitation_seasonality, Temperature_seasonality, frugivore_rich) %>% 
  scale() %>% 
  as.data.frame()

模型构建

RDA <- rda(RDA_indice ~., RDA_factors, scale = TRUE)

置换检验

per_test <- anova(RDA, permutations = 999)

kable(per_test, format = "html", caption = "") %>%
  kable_styling(full_width = TRUE, bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"))
Df Variance F Pr(>F)
Model 7 2.324806 18.4377 0.001
Residual 93 1.675194 NA NA

VIF 共线性检验

vif <- vif.cca(RDA)

vif.df <- data.frame(
  Variable = names(vif),
  VIF = as.numeric(vif)
)

kable(vif.df, format = "html", col.names = c("Environmental variable", "VIF")) %>% 
  kable_styling(full_width = TRUE)

3.2 可视化

提取排序结果数据

rda_scores <- scores(RDA, display = c("sites", "species"))
sites_scores <- as.data.frame(rda_scores$sites)
colnames(sites_scores) <- c("RDA1", "RDA2")  # 重命名坐标轴
sites_scores$latitude <- indice$latitude

species_scores <- as.data.frame(rda_scores$species)
colnames(species_scores) <- c("RDA1", "RDA2")

env_scores <- as.data.frame(RDA$CCA$biplot[,1:2])
colnames(env_scores) <- c("RDA1", "RDA2")

kable(env_scores, "html") %>% 
  kable_styling(latex_options = c("striped", "hold_position"))
RDA1 RDA2

绘图

require(ggrepel)
RDA_fig <- ggplot() +

  # 添加X轴和Y轴
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey", size = 1.5) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey", size = 1.5) +
  # 绘制样本点
  geom_point(data = sites_scores, aes(x = RDA1, y = RDA2, colour = latitude), size = 4, alpha = 0.7) +
  scale_color_viridis_c(direction = -1) +
  # 绘制物种箭头（带箭头的线）
  geom_segment(data = species_scores, aes(x = 0, y = 0, xend = RDA1, yend = RDA2), 
               arrow = arrow(type = "closed", length = unit(0.2, "inches")), 
               color = "grey33", size = 1) +
  # 添加物种标签
  geom_text_repel(data = species_scores, aes(x = RDA1, y = RDA2, label = c("Divergence", 'Evenness', "Fruiting peak", "Fruiting duration")), size = 5, color =  "grey33") +
  
  # 绘制环境因子箭头
  geom_segment(data = env_scores, aes(x = 0, y = 0, xend = RDA1, yend = RDA2),
               arrow = arrow(type = "closed", length = unit(0.2, "inches")), 
               color = "#B2182B", size = 1) +
  # 添加环境因子标签
  geom_text_repel(data = env_scores, aes(x = RDA1, y = RDA2, label = c("PF (9.47%)", "AET (22.89%)", "AP (14.80%)", 'AMT (17.81%)', "PS (15.80%)", "TS (8.38%)", "FR (10.88%)")), size = 5, color = "#B2182B") +
  theme_bw() + 
  labs(y = "RDA2 (19.30%)") +
  labs(x = "RDA1 (79.89%)",
       colour = 'Latitude (°)') +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(plot.title =  element_text(size = 15),
        panel.border = element_rect(size = 0.8, color = "black"), 
        legend.text = element_text( size = 15), 
        legend.key.size = unit(25, "pt"), 
        
        legend.title = element_text(
          size = 18,
          hjust = 0.5,
          margin = margin(b = 10)),
        
        axis.title = element_text(size = 17),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 15),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 15, angle = 90, hjust = 1, color = "black"))
